versions.changelog:
**Changelog for version 1.0.9**

- Skill renamed and rebranded to focus on "no subtitles": now forbids all subtitles, captions, text overlays, title cards, price stickers, or generated UI text by default.
- All video scripts and handoff notes enforce a strict no-on-screen-text policy; selling points and promotions should use voiceover and visuals only.
- Description and core workflow updated to clarify "no subtitles/text overlay" as a default requirement across all directions and video handoffs.
- Handoff prompts to video generation tools now explicitly include a "no text" constraint for every video type.
- Added policy reiteration to quality checks: now ensures zero planned subtitles or text overlays in output.
- General documentation refreshed to highlight differences from previous subtitle/text-overlay-enabled versions.

Version 1.0.8

- No file changes detected in this release.
- No updates to features, logic, or documentation.

Version 1.0.7

- Script structure updated: scripts now use a continuous structure without timestamp tables, with a continuous visual flow instead of segmented shots.
- Clarified handoff to video generation: added explicit instruction not to split scripts into multiple video segments or generate intermediate storyboard/character images for non-TVC videos; generation must be a single, complete video.
- Enhanced batch processing guidance for multiple scripts: explicitly state not to merge scripts into one prompt and ensure each runs as a separate video task.
- Refined constraints for non-TVC handoff, reinforcing one-step final video output and stronger isolation between sessions and product tasks.
- Minor editorial improvements for clarity and guidance consistency.

- Refined the video handoff process: Scripts are now passed directly and unchanged to video generation tools without rewriting or optimization.
- Clarified that, by default, audio/voiceover is generated directly via the video tool—no separate TTS or post-process compositing unless explicitly requested.
- Tightened batch handling: Each script must be submitted as a separate video task in LibTV; batch prompts should not merge multiple scripts.
- Updated terminology: “video handoff notes” replaces “AI video generation prompt” for clarity.
- Improved instructions for isolation between product tasks to prevent context inheritance across projects.

- Clarified boundaries: Selecting a script direction no longer initiates video generation—video tasks now require explicit user instruction.
- Updated workflow steps to consistently stop after script delivery and present next actions before any video generation.
- Added clear guidelines to prevent automatic calls to video generation tools like LibTV unless the user explicitly requests it.
- Refined handoff instructions for video generation, ensuring scripts and prompts are used only after explicit consent.
- Improved language throughout for clearer separation between scriptwriting and video making.

**Direct video generation is now more precise for non-TVC scripts.**

- Updated the direction list to mention 直播间带货 and 商业广告/TVC explicitly.
- Clarified that `直接生成视频` for non-TVC directions requires immediate complete video output—no intermediate storyboards or segment approvals.
- Specified handoff prompt wording for non-TVC tasks, emphasizing direct generation and use of the product reference image.
- Added detailed steps for project/session isolation and LibTV tool workflow when changing products.
- Enhanced instructions for TVC (商业广告) scripts: storyboards and sequential processing remain required, with automatic progression unless user opts to review.

Version 1.0.3

- Added a new requirement: when handing off to a video generation skill/tool, always begin with an explicit sentence specifying the generation target (duration, ratio, audio) unless the user requested otherwise.
- The handoff must start with: `请生成一条15秒、9:16竖屏、带声音/口播的短视频。`
- This ensures critical video generation settings are communicated clearly and not only via script tables.
- No file or code changes detected; SKILL.md update only.

Version 1.0.2 of product-video-script-skill

- No file changes detected in this version.
- No updates or modifications to the skill logic or documentation.
- Functionality, core rules, workflow, and references remain unchanged.

- Added integration configuration: new `agents/openai.yaml` file introduced.
- Improved multi-script handling for `商业广告/TVC`: now requires serial batch execution (one TVC storyboard/video at a time).
- Updated SKILL.md to clarify multi-TVC video handoff workflow and prevent simultaneous session submissions.

- Initial release of product-video-script skill for generating ecommerce product video scripts from images and selling points.
- Supports research-enhanced script generation with fallback playbooks when research is unavailable; clearly labels scripts as research- or fallback-based.
- Offers 5–7 video content directions, including TikTok style, live selling, and campaign promotions, with user guidance.
- Script output includes timecoded script, voiceover, shot/action, on-screen text, visual notes, and optional AI video prompt, defaulting to 15s/9:16 unless specified.
- Ensures campaign language is only used when an explicit campaign is requested or visible; otherwise, scripts remain evergreen.
- Integrates with video generation skills, includes batching logic, storyboard-first handoff for commercials, and clear cross-skill communication guidelines.
